description: Implementation of a socket adaptor class for UNIX domain sockets, handling connection setup, data transfer, listening, and threading.

classes.name: socket_adaptor
classes.description: A class managing UNIX domain socket connections, data transfer, and threading for socket communication.

methods.name: socket_adaptor
methods.description: Constructor initializing socket adaptor, setting up signal handling and pipes.

methods.name: ~socket_adaptor
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources and stopping listening.

methods.name: connect_socket
methods.description: Establishes a UNIX socket connection to a specified path.

methods.name: write_data
methods.description: Writes data to the connected socket.

methods.name: fetch_data
methods.description: Reads data from the socket into internal buffer.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves data from internal buffer into provided vector.

methods.name: start_listening
methods.description: Starts listening on a UNIX socket at specified path.

methods.name: stop_listening
methods.description: Stops listening and cleans up socket resources.

methods.name: worker_thread
methods.description: Thread function managing socket events and control messages.

methods.name: process_control_message
methods.description: Handles control messages like callback registration.
